description: Defines an immutable 'Note' class representing a note entity with properties like id, title, content, timestamps, pin status, and color. Includes methods for copying, serializing/deserializing, and equality checks.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: An immutable data class for notes, providing copy, serialization, and comparison functionalities.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Note with optional updated fields.

methods.name: fromMap
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a Note instance from a Map.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Converts the Note instance into a Map suitable for storage or transmission.
